cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Agree to the Exact Words
cards.instruction: Agree to the exact wording, then use later callbacks to narrow what those words can obligate you to do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I agreed to watch your dog today. Please give me a collection time before midnight.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tomorrow's only a few hours away. I could come at one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One is tomorrow. Put the handover inside today; we need the right date, not the nearest convenient hour.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You said you loved having him here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I do. His food and lead will be packed for you by eleven. Please collect both with him; loving the guest doesn't change the word 'today'.
